BiblicalUsage: Ballahah is terror, sudden alarm that destroys. Job's friends say terrors take hold of the wicked like waters, the king of terrors drags him from his tent, Isaiah says the enemy is gone by morning, and Ezekiel says Tyre will become a terror and be no more.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that terror is the portion of those who build against God. The prophets use this word the way a man points at a ruin: here is what is left of everyone who trusted in himself.
